title: Customer Profile v1
description: Customer Profile carries branding and policy only. First version does NOT design arbitrary hiddenMenus, roleRestrictions, or general policy DSL.

profileVersion.description: Locked to 1 for v1. Bump only when fields change type/semantics or are removed.

logoUrl.description: Optional webpack-resolved runtime asset URL; absent from profile.json.

darkLogoUrl.description: Optional webpack-resolved logo for dark theme; absent from profile.json. Header falls back to logoUrl when omitted.

loginLogoUrl.description: Optional webpack-resolved login-page logo; absent from profile.json. Login falls back to logoUrl when omitted.

darkLoginLogoUrl.description: Optional webpack-resolved dark-theme login-page logo; absent from profile.json. Login falls back to darkLogoUrl/logoUrl when omitted.

faviconUrl.description: Optional webpack-resolved runtime asset URL; absent from profile.json.

loginBackgroundUrl.description: Optional webpack-resolved runtime asset URL; absent from profile.json.

qrCodeUrl.description: Optional webpack-resolved runtime QR asset URL; absent from profile.json.

appIconUrl.description: Optional webpack-resolved runtime app icon URL; absent from profile.json.

theme.description: Whitelist of CSS Variables only. No Sass entry selected by CUSTOMER_ID; no arbitrary CSS/HTML/JS injection.

disabledCapabilities.description: Can only reference capabilities in CUSTOMER_DISABLEABLE_CAPABILITIES; can only disable Model Profile existing capabilities, cannot enable missing ones.
